stageReview.eyes: pass: both eyes visible, nose and mouth hidden
stageReview.nose: pass: nose revealed, mouth and teeth hidden; V1 .53 leaked upper teeth, V2 .49 corrected
stageReview.mouth: pass: lips and teeth visible, chin not fully revealed
stageReview.chin: pass: full chin and jaw visible, no obstruction
stageReview.full: pass: single face, eyes/nose/mouth/chin clear, no microphone, watermark or second face; slight head tilt is acceptable

decisions.identityEvidence: Commons caption explicitly identifies 大元 at 2012 event, original uploader's own photograph; structured depicts points to Dayuan Q9293309. Cross-checked stage face against source metadata; not based on automated face recognition.
decisions.rightsEvidence: Commons author 邱鈺鋒 (Kuyohong) declares own work under CC BY-SA 4.0, upload history and camera EXIF corroborate original photography; cropping and share-alike redistribution permitted with attribution and derivative notice.
decisions.recognitionEvidence: 2012 solo event portrait, both eyes and full smiling face visible, clear enough for five-stage gameplay despite head tilt; no obstructed mouth or chin.
decisions.reason: Opened actual 1000×1500 source, 600×720 JPEG and V1/V2 eyes/nose/mouth/chin/full PNGs. V1 nose stage rejected for teeth leakage; V2 corrected and all five stages passed. This is approval for review-branch integration only; no playable claim before Actions and public Pages QA.
